madād dambhodbhavo bhūtāvamānī haihayaścārjunaḥ dambhodbhavo+bhūta · tam ācāryaṃ śiṣyaḥ pitaraṃ putro bhṛtyaḥ svāminam iva cānuvarteta putro+bhṛtyaḥ · vṛttikāmāṃścopajapet etenaiva veṣeṇa rājārthaścaritavyo bhaktavetanakāle copasthātavyam iti caritavyaḥ→rājārthaścaritavyo +bhakta · śrūyate hi śukasārikābhir mantro bhinnaḥ śvabhir apyanyaiśca tiryagyonibhir iti mantro+bhinnaḥ

saṃśrutyārthān vipralabdhaḥ tulyakāriṇoḥ śilpe vopakāre vā vimānitaḥ vallabhāvaruddhaḥ samāhūya parājitaḥ pravāsopataptaḥ kṛtvā vyayam alabdhakāryaḥ svadharmād dāyādyād voparuddhaḥ mānādhikārābhyāṃ bhraṣṭaḥ kulyair antarhitaḥ prasabhābhimṛṣṭastrīkaḥ kārābhinyastaḥ paroktadaṇḍitaḥ mithyācāravāritaḥ sarvasvam āhāritaḥ bandhanaparikliṣṭaḥ pravāsitabandhuḥ iti kruddhavargaḥ mithyā+ācāra→mithyācāravāritaḥ · svayam upahataḥ viprakṛtaḥ pāpakarmābhikhyātaḥ tulyadoṣadaṇḍenodvignaḥ paryāttabhūmiḥ daṇḍenopanataḥ sarvādhikaraṇasthaḥ sahasopacitārthaḥ tatkulīno vāśaṃsuḥ pradviṣṭo rājñā rājadveṣī ca iti bhītavargaḥ vā+āśaṃsuḥ→vāśaṃsuḥ · tasmād devatāśramapāṣaṇḍaśrotriyapaśupuṇyasthānānāṃ bālavṛddhavyādhitavyasanyanāthānāṃ strīṇāṃ ca krameṇa kāryāṇi paśyet kāryagauravād ātyayikavaśena vā devatā+āśrama→devatāśramapāṣaṇḍaśrotriyapaśupuṇyasthānānāṃ · kośagṛhavidhānena madhye vāsagṛham gūḍhabhittisaṃcāraṃ mohanagṛhaṃ tanmadhye vā vāsagṛham bhūmigṛhaṃ vāsannacaityakāṣṭhadevatāpidhānadvāram anekasuruṅgāsaṃcāraṃ tasyopari prāsādaṃ gūḍhabhittisopānaṃ suṣirastambhapraveśāpasāraṃ vā vāsagṛhaṃ yantrabaddhatalāvapātaṃ kārayet āpatpratīkārārtham āpadi vā vā+āsanna→vāsannacaityakāṣṭhadevatāpidhānadvāram

sāṃkhyaṃ yogo lokāyataṃ cetyānvīkṣikī yogo+lokāyataṃ · śulkaṃ daṇḍaḥ pautavaṃ nāgariko lakṣaṇādhyakṣo mudrādhyakṣaḥ surā sūnā sūtraṃ tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣāraḥ sauvarṇikaḥ paṇyasaṃsthā veśyā dyūtaṃ vāstukaṃ kāruśilpigaṇo devatādhyakṣo dvārabāhirikādeyaṃ ca durgam nāgariko+lakṣaṇa · nityo nityotpādiko lābho lābhotpādika iti vyayaḥ lābho+lābha · nityo nityotpādiko lābho lābhotpādika iti vyayaḥ utpādikaḥ→nityotpādiko +lābho

mānād rāvaṇaḥ paradārān aprayacchan duryodhano rājyād aṃśaṃ ca mānād+rāvaṇaḥ · sa sattribhiḥ śapathapūrvam ekaikam amātyam upajāpayet adhārmiko 'yaṃ rājā sādhu dhārmikam anyam asya tatkulīnam aparuddhaṃ kulyam ekapragrahaṃ sāmantam āṭavikam aupapādikaṃ vā pratipādayāmaḥ sarveṣām etad rocate kathaṃ vā tava iti etad+rocate · senāpatir asatpragraheṇāvakṣiptaḥ sattribhir ekaikam amātyam upajāpayet lobhanīyenārthena rājavināśāya sarveṣām etad rocate kathaṃ vā tava iti etad+rocate · kāpaṭikaścātra pūrvāvaruddhasteṣām arthamānāvakṣiptam ekaikam amātyam upajapet asatpravṛtto 'yaṃ rājā sādhvenaṃ hatvānyaṃ pratipādayāmaḥ sarveṣām etad rocate kathaṃ vā tava iti etad+rocate

sabandhurāṣṭrā rājāno vineśur ajitendriyāḥ rāṣṭrāḥ→sabandhurāṣṭrā +rājāno · sūdārālikasnāpakasaṃvāhakāstarakakalpakaprasādhakodakaparicārakā rasadāḥ kubjavāmanakirātamūkabadhirajaḍāndhacchadmāno naṭanartakagāyanavādakavāgjīvanakuśīlavāḥ striyaścābhyantaraṃ cāraṃ vidyuḥ paricārakāḥ→sūdārālikasnāpakasaṃvāhakāstarakakalpakaprasādhakodakaparicārakā +rasadāḥ · karṣakodāsthitā rāṣṭre rāṣṭrānte vrajavāsinaḥ udāsthitāḥ→karṣakodāsthitā +rāṣṭre · tena bhṛtā rājānaḥ prajānāṃ yogakṣemāvahāḥ bhṛtā+rājānaḥ

jānapado 'bhijātaḥ svavagrahaḥ kṛtaśilpaścakṣuṣmān prājño dhārayiṣṇur dakṣo vāgmī pragalbhaḥ pratipattimān utsāhaprabhāvayuktaḥ kleśasahaḥ śucir maitro dṛḍhabhaktiḥ śīlabalārogyasattvayuktaḥ stambhacāpalahīnaḥ sampriyo vairāṇām akartetyamātyasampat su+avagrahaḥ→svavagrahaḥ · mantripurohitasakhaḥ sāmānyeṣvadhikaraṇeṣu sthāpayitvāmātyān upadhābhiḥ śodhayet sāmānyeṣu+adhikaraṇeṣu→sāmānyeṣvadhikaraṇeṣu · taṃ sattriṇaḥ saṃsthāsvarpayeyuḥ saṃsthāsu+arpayeyuḥ→saṃsthāsvarpayeyuḥ · taṃ bhikṣukyaḥ saṃsthāsvarpayeyuḥ saṃsthāsu+arpayeyuḥ→saṃsthāsvarpayeyuḥ

teṣāṃ janapadabhijanam avagrahaṃ cāptataḥ parīkṣeta samānavidyebhyaḥ śilpaṃ śāstracakṣuṣmattāṃ ca karmārambheṣu prajñāṃ dhārayiṣṇutāṃ dākṣyaṃ ca kathāyogeṣu vāgmitvaṃ prāgalbhyaṃ pratibhānavattvaṃ ca saṃvāsibhyaḥ śīlabalārogyasattvayogam astambham acāpalaṃ ca pratyakṣataḥ sampriyatvam avairatvaṃ ca prajñāṃ+dhārayiṣṇu · nāgatvāntaṃ nivarteta sthitā sattvavatāṃ dhṛtau sattvavatāṃ+dhṛtau · yathā śvagaṇināṃ dhenuḥ śvabhyo duhyate na brāhmaṇebhyaḥ evam ayaṃ rājā sattvaprajñāvākyaśaktihīnebhyo duhyate nātmaguṇasampannebhyaḥ asau rājā puruṣaviśeṣajñaḥ tatra gamyatām iti lubdhavargam upajāpayet gaṇinām→śvagaṇināṃ +dhenuḥ · savatsāṃ dhenuṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca pradakṣiṇīkṛtyopasthānaṃ gacchet vatsām→savatsāṃ +dhenuṃ

purohitam uditoditakulaśīlaṃ sāṅge vede daive nimitte daṇḍanītyāṃ cābhivinītam āpadāṃ daivamānuṣīṇām atharvabhir upāyaiśca pratikartāraṃ kurvīta atharvabhir+upāyaiḥ · kṛtā ca kaluṣā buddhir upadhābhiścaturvidhā buddhir+upadhābhiḥ · ātmasaṃbhāvitaḥ mānakāmaḥ śatrupūjāmarṣitaḥ nīcair upahitaḥ tīkṣṇaḥ sāhasikaḥ bhogenāsaṃtuṣṭaḥ iti mānivargaḥ nīcair+upahitaḥ · teṣāṃ hi pramādamadasuptapralāpāḥ kāmādir utsekaḥ pracchanno 'vamato vā mantraṃ bhinatti ādiḥ→kāmādir +utsekaḥ

pṛṣṭhataḥ kakṣyāvibhāge strīniveśo garbhavyādhisaṃsthā vṛkṣodakasthānaṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ+kakṣyā · bahiḥ kanyākumārapuram bahiḥ+kanyā · niryāṇe 'bhiyāne ca rājamārgam ubhayataḥ kṛtārakṣaṃ śastribhir daṇḍibhiścāpāstaśastrahastapravrajitavyaṅgaṃ gacchet ubhayataḥ+kṛta · pūrvaṃ siddhaṃ paścād avatāritam paścāt siddhaṃ pūrvam avatāritam sādhyaṃ na siddham asādhyaṃ siddham siddham asiddhaṃ kṛtam asiddhaṃ siddhaṃ kṛtam alpasiddhaṃ bahu kṛtam bahusiddham alpaṃ kṛtam anyat siddham anyat kṛtam anyataḥ siddham anyataḥ kṛtam deyaṃ na dattam adeyaṃ dattam kāle na dattam akāle dattam alpaṃ dattaṃ bahu kṛtam bahu dattam alpaṃ kṛtam anyad dattam anyat kṛtam anyato dattam anyataḥ kṛtam praviṣṭam apraviṣṭaṃ kṛtam apraviṣṭaṃ praviṣṭaṃ kṛtam kupyam adattamūlyaṃ praviṣṭam dattamūlyaṃ na praviṣṭaṃ saṃkṣepo vikṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ vikṣepaḥ saṃkṣepo vā mahārgham alpārgheṇa parivartitam alpārghaṃ mahārgheṇa vā samāropito 'rghaḥ pratyavaropito vā saṃvatsaro māsaviṣamaḥ kṛtaḥ māso divasaviṣamo vā samāgamaviṣamaḥ mukhaviṣamaḥ kārmikaviṣamaḥ nirvartanaviṣamaḥ piṇḍaviṣamaḥ varṇaviṣamaḥ arghaviṣamaḥ mānaviṣamaḥ māpanaviṣamaḥ bhājanaviṣamaḥ iti haraṇopāyāḥ anyataḥ+kṛtam

jānapado 'bhijātaḥ svavagrahaḥ kṛtaśilpaścakṣuṣmān prājño dhārayiṣṇur dakṣo vāgmī pragalbhaḥ pratipattimān utsāhaprabhāvayuktaḥ kleśasahaḥ śucir maitro dṛḍhabhaktiḥ śīlabalārogyasattvayuktaḥ stambhacāpalahīnaḥ sampriyo vairāṇām akartetyamātyasampat jānapado+'bhijātaḥ · prahavaṇanimittam eko 'mātyaḥ sarvān amātyān āvāhayet eko+'mātyaḥ · tasmād uñchaṣaḍbhāgam āraṇyakāpi nirvapanti tasyaitad bhāgadheyaṃ yo 'smān gopāyati iti yo+'smān · tān avamanyamānān daivo 'pi daṇḍaḥ spṛśati daivo+'pi

pravrajyāpratyavasitaḥ prajñāśaucayukta udāsthitaḥ yuktaḥ→prajñāśaucayukta +udāsthitaḥ · trayaḥ prācīnā rājamārgāstraya udīcīnā iti vāstuvibhāgaḥ trayaḥ→rājamārgāstraya +udīcīnā · vaiḍūryam utpalavarṇaḥ śirīṣapuṣpaka udakavarṇo vaṃśarāgaḥ śukapattravarṇaḥ puṣyarāgo gomūtrako gomedakaḥ śirīṣapuṣpaka+udaka · avakṣepaḥ pratimānam agnir gaṇḍikā bhaṇḍikādhikaraṇī piñchaḥ sūtraṃ cellaṃ bollanaṃ śira utsaṅgo makṣikā svakāyekṣā dṛtir udakaśarāvam agniṣṭham iti kācaṃ vidyāt śira+utsaṅgo

teṣāṃ muṇḍajaṭilavyañjanair yo yadbhaktiḥ kṛtyapakṣīyastaṃ tenopajāpayet yo+yad · yathā madāndho hastī mattenādhiṣṭhito yad yad āsādayati tat sarvaṃ pramṛdnāti evam ayam aśāstracakṣur andho rājā paurajānapadavadhāyābhyutthitaḥ śakyam asya pratihastiprotsāhanenāpakartum amarṣaḥ kriyatām iti kruddhavargam upajāpayet adhiṣṭhitaḥ→mattenādhiṣṭhito +yad · yathā līnaḥ sarpo yasmād bhayaṃ paśyati tatra viṣam utsṛjati evam ayaṃ rājā jātadoṣāśaṅkastvayi purā krodhaviṣam utsṛjati anyatra gamyatām iti bhītavargam upajāpayet sarpo+yasmād · sa dvādaśadvāro yuktodakabhramacchannapathaḥ dvāraḥ→dvādaśadvāro +yukta

tajjātakaraṇādhiṣṭhitaḥ purāṇaṃ navaṃ ca ratnaṃ sāraṃ phalgu kupyaṃ vā pratigṛhṇīyāt tad+jāta→tajjātakaraṇādhiṣṭhitaḥ · uttamamadhyamāvareṣu ca karmasu tajjātikam adhyakṣaṃ kuryāt sāmudayikeṣvavakﾱptikam vyayam upahatya rājā nānutapyeta tad+jātikam→tajjātikam · anugraho yo nṛpater nideśāt tajjñaḥ parīhāra iti vyavasyet tad+jñaḥ→tajjñaḥ · kośādhyakṣaḥ kośapraveśyaṃ ratnaṃ sāraṃ phalguṃ kupyaṃ vā tajjātakaraṇādhiṣṭhitaḥ pratigṛhṇīyāt tad+jāta→tajjātakaraṇādhiṣṭhitaḥ

kopājjanamejayo brāhmaṇeṣu vikrāntaḥ tālajaṅghaśca bhṛguṣu janamejayaḥ→kopājjanamejayo +brāhmaṇeṣu · ambarīṣaśca nābhāgo bubhujāte ciraṃ mahīm nābhāgo+bubhujāte · ṛtvigācāryapurohitaśrotriyebhyo brahmadeyāny adaṇḍakarāṇy abhirūpadāyādakāni prayacchet adhyakṣasaṃkhyāyakādibhyo gopasthānikānīkasthacikitsakāśvadamakajaṅghākārikebhyaśca vikrayādhānavarjāni śrotriyebhyaḥ→ṛtvigācāryapurohitaśrotriyebhyo +brahma · tataḥ paraṃ nagararājadevatālohamaṇikāravo brāhmaṇāścottarāṃ diśam adhivaseyuḥ kāravaḥ→nagararājadevatālohamaṇikāravo +brāhmaṇāḥ

saṃśrutyārthān vipralabdhaḥ tulyakāriṇoḥ śilpe vopakāre vā vimānitaḥ vallabhāvaruddhaḥ samāhūya parājitaḥ pravāsopataptaḥ kṛtvā vyayam alabdhakāryaḥ svadharmād dāyādyād voparuddhaḥ mānādhikārābhyāṃ bhraṣṭaḥ kulyair antarhitaḥ prasabhābhimṛṣṭastrīkaḥ kārābhinyastaḥ paroktadaṇḍitaḥ mithyācāravāritaḥ sarvasvam āhāritaḥ bandhanaparikliṣṭaḥ pravāsitabandhuḥ iti kruddhavargaḥ vā+upakāre→vopakāre · saṃśrutyārthān vipralabdhaḥ tulyakāriṇoḥ śilpe vopakāre vā vimānitaḥ vallabhāvaruddhaḥ samāhūya parājitaḥ pravāsopataptaḥ kṛtvā vyayam alabdhakāryaḥ svadharmād dāyādyād voparuddhaḥ mānādhikārābhyāṃ bhraṣṭaḥ kulyair antarhitaḥ prasabhābhimṛṣṭastrīkaḥ kārābhinyastaḥ paroktadaṇḍitaḥ mithyācāravāritaḥ sarvasvam āhāritaḥ bandhanaparikliṣṭaḥ pravāsitabandhuḥ iti kruddhavargaḥ vā+uparuddhaḥ→voparuddhaḥ · svayam upahataḥ viprakṛtaḥ pāpakarmābhikhyātaḥ tulyadoṣadaṇḍenodvignaḥ paryāttabhūmiḥ daṇḍenopanataḥ sarvādhikaraṇasthaḥ sahasopacitārthaḥ tatkulīno vāśaṃsuḥ pradviṣṭo rājñā rājadveṣī ca iti bhītavargaḥ sahasā+upacita→sahasopacitārthaḥ · śāsanaṃ ca yathoktaṃ brūyāt prāṇābādhe 'pi dṛṣṭe yathā+uktam→yathoktaṃ

tena hi dhvajenāditikauśikavad asya mātṛbāndhavā bhikṣeran bāndhavāḥ→mātṛbāndhavā +bhikṣeran · nāgavanapālā hastipakapādapāśikasaumikavanacarakapārikarmikasakhā hastimūtrapurīṣacchannagandhā bhallātakīśākhāpracchannāḥ pañcabhiḥ saptabhir vā hastibandhakībhiḥ saha carantaḥ śayyāsthānapadyāleṇḍakūlaghātoddeśena hastikulaparyagraṃ vidyuḥ gandhāḥ→hastimūtrapurīṣacchannagandhā +bhallātaka · sahagrāhiṇaḥ pratibhuvaḥ karmopajīvinaḥ putrā bhrātaro bhāryā duhitaro bhṛtyāścāsya karmacchedaṃ vaheyuḥ putrā+bhrātaro · saṃhatā bhakṣayeyuḥ vigṛhītā vināśayeyuḥ saṃhatā+bhakṣayeyuḥ

sa yadyekaputraḥ putrotpattāvasya prayateta sa+yadi · matsyā yathāntaḥ salile caranto jñātuṃ na śakyāḥ salilaṃ pibantaḥ matsyā+yathā · udārakastulyaḥ yavā godhūmāśca kṣuṇṇāḥ tilā yavā mudgamāṣāśca ghṛṣṭāḥ tilā+yavā · abhūmiṣṭhānāṃ hi svabhūmiṣṭhā yuddhe pratilomā bhavanti sthāḥ→svabhūmiṣṭhā +yuddhe

vāstucchidrānuśāleṣu śreṇīprapaṇinikāyā āvaseyuḥ prapaṇinikāyāḥ→śreṇīprapaṇinikāyā +āvaseyuḥ · bāhyeṣu tu pracchannam ahani kṣetrakhalaveśmāpaṇebhyaḥ kupyabhāṇḍam upaskaraṃ vā māṣamūlyād ūrdhvam ā pādamūlyād ityapaharatastripaṇo daṇḍaḥ gomayapradehena vā pralipyāvaghoṣaṇam ā dvipādamūlyād iti ṣaṭpaṇaḥ gomayabhasmanā vā pralipyāvaghoṣaṇam ā tripādamūlyād iti navapaṇaḥ gomayabhasmanā vā pralipyāvaghoṣaṇam śarāvamekhalayā vā ā paṇamūlyād iti dvādaśapaṇaḥ muṇḍanaṃ pravrājanaṃ vā ā dvipaṇamūlyād iti caturviṃśatipaṇaḥ muṇḍasyeṣṭakāśakalena pravrājanaṃ vā ā catuṣpaṇamūlyād iti ṣaṭtriṃśatpaṇa ā pañcapaṇamūlyād ityaṣṭacatvāriṃśatpaṇaḥ ā daśapaṇamūlyād iti pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍa ā viṃśatipaṇamūlyād iti dviśata ā triṃśatpaṇamūlyād iti pañcaśata ā catvāriṃśatpaṇamūlyād iti sāhasra ā jānapado 'bhijātaḥ svavagrahaḥ kṛtaśilpaścakṣuṣmān prājño dhārayiṣṇur dakṣo vāgmī pragalbhaḥ pratipattimān utsāhaprabhāvayuktaḥ kleśasahaḥ śucir maitro dṛḍhabhaktiḥ śīlabalārogyasattvayuktaḥ stambhacāpalahīnaḥ sampriyo vairāṇām akartetyamātyasampat dhārayiṣṇur+dakṣo · akṛtyān kṛtyapakṣīyair darśitān kāryahetubhiḥ pakṣīyaiḥ→kṛtyapakṣīyair +darśitān · śayanād utthitaḥ strīgaṇair dhanvibhiḥ parigṛhyate dvitīyasyāṃ kakṣyāyāṃ kaṃcukoṣṇīṣibhir varṣadharābhyāgārikaiḥ tṛtīyasyāṃ kubjavāmanakirātaiḥ caturthyāṃ mantribhiḥ sambandhibhir dauvārikaiśca prāsapāṇibhiḥ sambandhibhir+dauvārikaiḥ · niryāṇe 'bhiyāne ca rājamārgam ubhayataḥ kṛtārakṣaṃ śastribhir daṇḍibhiścāpāstaśastrahastapravrajitavyaṅgaṃ gacchet śastribhir+daṇḍibhiḥ

adhikuryād yathā śaucam ityācāryā vyavasthitāḥ adhikuryād+yathā · yathā madāndho hastī mattenādhiṣṭhito yad yad āsādayati tat sarvaṃ pramṛdnāti evam ayam aśāstracakṣur andho rājā paurajānapadavadhāyābhyutthitaḥ śakyam asya pratihastiprotsāhanenāpakartum amarṣaḥ kriyatām iti kruddhavargam upajāpayet yad+yad · evam ayaṃ navabuddhir yad yad ucyate tat tatśāstropadeśam ivābhijānāti yad+yad · bahuputraḥ pratyantam anyaviṣayaṃ vā preṣayed yatra garbhaḥ paṇyaṃ ḍimbo vā na bhavet preṣayed+yatra

mātsyanyāyābhibhūtāḥ prajā manuṃ vaivasvataṃ rājānaṃ cakrire prajā+manuṃ · aṣṭaśatagrāmyā madhye sthānīyam catuḥśatagrāmyā droṇamukham dviśatagrāmyāḥ kārvaṭikam daśagrāmīsaṃgraheṇa saṃgrahaṃ sthāpayet grāmyāḥ→aṣṭaśatagrāmyā +madhye · dāśārṇāścāparāntāśca dvipānāṃ madhyamā matāḥ madhyamā+matāḥ · yaḥ pitṛpaitāmaham artham anyāyena bhakṣayati sa mūlaharaḥ sa+mūla

dharmādharmau trayyām arthānarthau vārttāyāṃ nayānayau daṇḍanītyāṃ balābale ca etāsāṃ hetubhir anvīkṣamāṇā lokasya upakaroti vyasane 'bhyudaye ca buddhim avasthāpayati prajñāvākyakriyāvaiśāradyaṃ ca karoti vyasane+'bhyudaye · ye cāsya dhānyapaśuhiraṇyānyājīvanti tair upakurvanti vyasane 'bhyudaye vā kupitaṃ bandhuṃ rāṣṭraṃ vā vyāvartayanti amitram āṭavikaṃ vā pratiṣedhayanti teṣāṃ muṇḍajaṭilavyañjanāstuṣṭātuṣṭatvaṃ vidyuḥ vyasane+'bhyudaye · śāsanaṃ ca yathoktaṃ brūyāt prāṇābādhe 'pi dṛṣṭe ābādhe+'pi · pratiṣṭhite 'hani saṃdhyām upāsīta pratiṣṭhite+'hani

teṣāṃ kilbiṣam adaṇḍakarā harantyayogakṣemāvahāśca prajānām karāḥ→adaṇḍakarā +haranti · taṃ brūyāt dūtamukhā hi rājānaḥ tvaṃ cānye ca mukhāḥ→dūtamukhā +hi · sukhoparuddhā hi putrāḥ pitaraṃ nābhidruhyanti iti uparuddhāḥ→sukhoparuddhā +hi · nāgavanapālā hastipakapādapāśikasaumikavanacarakapārikarmikasakhā hastimūtrapurīṣacchannagandhā bhallātakīśākhāpracchannāḥ pañcabhiḥ saptabhir vā hastibandhakībhiḥ saha carantaḥ śayyāsthānapadyāleṇḍakūlaghātoddeśena hastikulaparyagraṃ vidyuḥ pālāḥ→nāgavanapālā +hastipaka

tāvanmātram ekadvāraṃ khātaguptaṃ svāduphalagulmaguccham akaṇṭakidrumam uttānatoyāśayaṃ dāntamṛgacatuṣpadaṃ bhagnanakhadaṃṣṭravyālaṃ mārgayukahastihastinīkalabhaṃ mṛgavanaṃ vihārārthaṃ rājñaḥ kārayet dvāram→ekadvāraṃ +khāta · paścimadakṣiṇaṃ bhāgaṃ kharoṣṭraguptisthānaṃ karmagṛhaṃ ca paścimottaraṃ bhāgaṃ yānarathaśālāḥ bhāgaṃ+khara · caturaśrāṃ vāpīm anudakopasnehāṃ khānayitvā pṛthuśilābhir ubhayataḥ pārśvaṃ mūlaṃ ca pracitya sāradārupañjaraṃ bhūmisamaṃ tritalam anekavidhānaṃ kuṭṭimadeśasthānatalam ekadvāraṃ yantrayuktasopānaṃ bhūmigṛhaṃ kārayet upasnehām→anudakopasnehāṃ +khānayitvā · samāhartā durgaṃ rāṣṭraṃ khaniṃ setuṃ vanaṃ vrajaṃ vaṇikpathaṃ cāvekṣeta rāṣṭraṃ+khaniṃ

daṇḍanītir ekā vidyetyauśanasāḥ vidyā+iti→vidyetyauśanasāḥ · jānapado 'bhijātaḥ svavagrahaḥ kṛtaśilpaścakṣuṣmān prājño dhārayiṣṇur dakṣo vāgmī pragalbhaḥ pratipattimān utsāhaprabhāvayuktaḥ kleśasahaḥ śucir maitro dṛḍhabhaktiḥ śīlabalārogyasattvayuktaḥ stambhacāpalahīnaḥ sampriyo vairāṇām akartetyamātyasampat akartā+iti→akartetyamātyasampat · tatheti pratipannāṃstān saṃhitān paṇakarmaṇā tathā+iti→tatheti · lājān madhuneti viṣeṇa paryasya devī kāśirājam viṣadigdhena nūpureṇa vairantyam mekhalāmaṇinā sauvīram jālūtham ādarśena veṇyāṃ gūḍhaṃ śastraṃ kṛtvā devī vidūrathaṃ jaghāna madhunā+iti→madhuneti

yathā līnaḥ sarpo yasmād bhayaṃ paśyati tatra viṣam utsṛjati evam ayaṃ rājā jātadoṣāśaṅkastvayi purā krodhaviṣam utsṛjati anyatra gamyatām iti bhītavargam upajāpayet yasmād+bhayaṃ · tatra yadbhūyiṣṭhā brūyuḥ kāryasiddhikaraṃ vā tat kuryāt yat+bhūyiṣṭhāḥ→yadbhūyiṣṭhā · yo yad yad utpadyate tat tad bhakṣayati sa tādātvikaḥ tad+bhakṣayati · yo 'haṃ sa bhavān yan mama dravyaṃ tad bhavataḥ ityupagrahaḥ sāntvam tad+bhavataḥ

teṣām ajātasnehe pitaryupāṃśudaṇḍaḥ śreyān iti bhāradvājaḥ pitari+upāṃśu→pitaryupāṃśudaṇḍaḥ · ananurūpaṃ bhavataḥ ityupālambhaḥ iti+upālambhaḥ→ityupālambhaḥ · yo 'haṃ sa bhavān yan mama dravyaṃ tad bhavataḥ ityupagrahaḥ sāntvam iti+upagrahaḥ→ityupagrahaḥ · koṣṭhāgārādhyakṣaḥ sītārāṣṭrakrayimaparivartakaprāmityakāpamityakasaṃhanikānyajātavyayapratyāyopasthānāny upalabhet upasthānāni→sītārāṣṭrakrayimaparivartakaprāmityakāpamityakasaṃhanikānyajātavyayapratyāyopasthānāny +upalabhet
